test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 144 743 290 258 799 (Right) (Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the third digit of the lowest number?
solution:
Given: (Left) 144 743 290 258 799 (Right)

According to the question:

 
 

 Given numbers
 144
 743
 290
 258
 799
 
 

 Numbers arranged in ascending order
 144
 258
 290
 743
 799
 
 

So,

Second digit of the highest number → 7__**9**__9 → 9

Third digit of the lowest number → 14__**4**__ → 4

Thus, if the second digit of the highest number is subtracted from the third digit of the lowest number then the resultant will be → 4 - 9 → -5 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
